DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL).

The CBC confirms pancytopenia (low hemoglobin and platelets) with a massive leukocytosis of 81,000/mm³. Crucially, the peripheral smear reveals myeloblasts with Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions), which are pathognomonic for APL. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate initiation of All-Trans Retinoic Acid (ATRA) to prevent fatal disseminated intravascular coagulation.
